title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Search: find people by SharePoint custom profile properties
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap target and distinguishes documented SharePoint controls from the planned Copilot Search capability. The licensing statements and corrected admin paths are supported; feature-specific defaults, controls and matching behaviour remain undocumented.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to find people in Copilot Search using the company's custom SharePoint Online profile properties.
claims.quote: Discover and find people through Microsoft 365 Copilot Search based on your company's custom profile properties from SharePoint Online.

claims.claim: The roadmap identifies Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) and calls the capability Microsoft 365 Copilot Search.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Search Supports SharePoint Online Custom Properties Search

claims.claim: User can override allows users to override the property's policy and privacy settings.
claims.quote: Select the User can override box to enable users to override these settings.

claims.claim: Allow users to edit values for this property controls whether users can change that profile information themselves.
claims.quote: If you want users to be able to change this profile information for themselves, select Allow users to edit values for this property.

claims.claim: Indexed is documented as making searches return user profiles matching the property.
claims.quote: Select the Indexed if you want searches to return all the user profiles matching that property.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: A tenant switch for Copilot Search custom-property search is not yet documented on either UI or API.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Search SharePoint custom profile properties tenant disable exclude property admin switch Microsoft Graph API. Opened Copilot Search FAQ, manage and admin experience; results describe other Copilot products and profile cards, not a switch for this feature.

claims.claim: More features > User profiles > Open > People > Manage User Properties is the SharePoint admin center route to inventory custom properties.
claims.quote: Go to More features in the new SharePoint admin center ... Select User profiles, and then select Open. Under People, choose Manage User Properties.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, edit or delete
claims.claim: Properties an administrator added can be edited or deleted from Manage User Properties.
claims.quote: Under People, choose Manage User Properties. ... In the Property Name column, select the profile property that you want to change, and then select Edit or Delete.

claims.claim: The CSOM method QueueImportProfileProperties queues bulk imports of custom profile-property values.
claims.quote: You can queue the CSOM API for the bulk import process by calling the QueueImportProfileProperties method located in the Office365Tenant object.

claims.claim: The bulk import works only for properties that end users cannot edit.
claims.quote: The import only works for user profile properties that have not been set to be editable by end users.

claims.claim: Executing the import API requires Global Admin permissions unless app-only authentication is used.
claims.quote: You must have Global Admin permissions currently, unless you use an app-only authentication context. SharePoint Admin is not sufficient.

claims.claim: Copilot > Search is the documented entry to the Copilot Search area in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center: ... From the left navigation menu, select Copilot from the dropdown menu and select Search.

claims.quote: Manage all your data sources with over 100 connectors within the Microsoft Catalog, custom connectors, and hundreds of connectors from integrated software vendors (ISVs).
